❓ Frequently asked questions

Is any of this scientifically accurate?

No. Zodiac signs are entertainment, not science — no sign can predict personality or the future.

What about Capricorn spanning two years?

Capricorn wraps around the new year (Dec 22 – Jan 19). The calculator handles the wrap correctly.

Is my birthdate stored or sent anywhere?

No — your birthdate never leaves your browser.
